# AGENTS.md — AI usage policy (CPSC 410)

## Course generative-AI policy

Using generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, coding agents, etc.) for assessments
is discouraged but permitted **if and only if** generated code is explicitly
marked with:

```ts
/** Start Code Generated by [TOOLNAME] on [DATE] */
/** End Code Generated by [TOOLNAME] on [DATE] */
```

## House rules for generated code in this repo

- Keep marking comments as few and as clean as possible: merge adjacent
  generated regions under a single Start/End pair whenever possible (e.g. one
  pair per file for a fully generated file).
- Fill in the real `[TOOLNAME]` and `[DATE]` — never leave the placeholders.
